steps: UI as sponsor (test wallet m4Ac…): My Profile, Create User Profile (username + URI)
UI: Admin, Approve Sponsor with its own address (any wallet can approve any profile)
UI: My Profile, Add Grant Program (3rZt…eAPP)
UI as dev (test wallet GpUq…): Create User Profile
UI as dev: Add New Project (HUAC…18kK1)
UI as sponsor: grant program page, Award Grant, 0.01 SOL to that project
UI as dev: project page, Add New Milestone, 0.005 SOL
UI as dev: Review (submit the milestone)
UI as sponsor: Settle Payment; the page then read the grant at 0.005 / 0.01 SOL and the milestone as paid
Script: approve_sponsor A, signed by unrelated wallet C as admin
Script: award_grant 0.02 SOL (native mint) by sponsor A
Script: add_grant_milestone #0 (0.015 SOL) by dev B
Script: add_grant_milestone #1 (0.01 SOL, over what is left of the grant) by dev B
Script: settle_grant_milestone #0: sponsor A pays dev B 0.015 SOL
Script: revise_grant_milestone #1 by sponsor A (sends it back to in-progress)
Script: add_grant_milestone #2 (0.001 SOL) by dev B
Script: reject_grant_milestone #2 by sponsor A: succeeds, but lib.rs routes reject to the accept code, so milestone #2 (Gy5X…zXtk) ends up Accepted, not Rejected
evidence.functional_evidence: reject_grant_milestone calls accept_milestone, so a "reject" accepts the milestone and the sponsor can then be asked to pay it. Proven on devnet for milestone #2. approve_sponsor also accepts any signer.
evidence.ui_check: tests/devnet/wallet_click.py barn <step> (sponsor-setup, dev-setup, award, milestone, review, settle; log: tests/devnet/logs/ui-clicks-2026-11-10.jsonl)

limitations: Bug: the program's reject_grant_milestone entry point calls accept_milestone, so "rejecting" a milestone in review accepts it, and the sponsor can then be asked to pay it. Our script's milestone #2 (Gy5XhNzwwXgq4dafotc27XtRVw6yv8MvCLeezGe6zXtk) is Accepted on devnet after its reject transaction; a post-run read confirms it.
approve_sponsor accepts any signer as "admin", so anyone can turn any fresh profile into a sponsor (the script shows an unrelated wallet doing it).
Settling a paid milestone a second time fails, but with ApprovedAmountExceeded when the cap check (which runs first) trips, so the error doesn't say the milestone was already paid.
Each wallet gets one profile on this program, ever (the authority PDA is keyed by the wallet).
The app shows names from each account's metadata URI; without one (or while the URI 404s) it shows "Untitled". It also shows Add New Milestone to sponsors, which the program rejects (NotADev).
Lists in the app ("Grant Programs: 0" right after creating one) can lag until you reload.
